answer: In a vouching-thread scheme, each new agent identity must be sponsored by a peer who locks 100 tokens per vouch, and a peer's bond scales quadratically with identities it vouches in the same thread: n fakes cost 100·n² tokens total. At zenith attack scale this becomes ruinous, and bonds are slashed if any vouched identity fails attestation within one epoch, while fraudulent shale-of-trust links propagate the slash to the sponsor's whole vouching thread.
